name: Secufor_OAuth
author: Secufor

sections.description:
Secufor_OAuth is a WordPress plugin that enables Single Sign-On (SSO) functionality using the OAuth protocol.

Features:
1. OAuth-based Single Sign-On (SSO)
2. Secure authentication with external applications
3. Simplifies user login experience
4. Centralized identity management
5. No need for multiple credentials across different platforms

Popular OAuth providers:

  • Google
  • Facebook
  • Twitter
  • GitHub
  • Microsoft
  • LinkedIn
  • Amazon
  • Apple
  • GitLab
  • Bitbucket
  • Slack
  • Discord
  • Spotify
  • Instagram
  • Reddit
  • Dropbox
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • Salesforce
  • Zoom
  • PayPal
  • Stripe
  • Twitch
  • WordPress.com
  • Keycloak

External services

https://secufor.net : Secufor website used to connect to your secufor account and retrieve your accounts informations to the plugin.
